This copy of Termux came from Google Play, so Pipkin won\'t use it. Uninstall it, then install Termux from F-Droid (uninstalling deletes Termux\'s files).
Pipkin can\'t confirm this copy of Termux is the official F-Droid build, so it won\'t use it. Uninstall it, then install Termux from F-Droid (uninstalling deletes Termux\'s files).
Only Termux from F-Droid, for your security

Your agent runs inside Termux, where it can reach your code, your files and the API keys you sign in with. A modified copy of Termux could read or change any of them, so before Pipkin runs anything, it checks that F-Droid signed your copy. Termux from Google Play, GitHub or anywhere else isn\'t accepted.
Termux %1$s is installed and verified as the official F-Droid build.
Shows when Pipkin is working in the background and lets you stop it.
Lets Pipkin keep following a chat while the screen is off. Without it, Android can cut Pipkin off from the agent mid-run.
Pipkin can run in the background.
Allow Pipkin to run commands in Termux
Pipkin runs its agent through Termux.
Android won\'t ask again. In settings, open Permissions and allow \"Run commands in Termux environment\".
Pipkin can run commands in Termux.
In Termux, long-press, tap Paste, then press Enter. Allow storage access when Android asks. Termux brings you back here when it\'s done.
Pipkin installs its agent (version %1$s) in Termux. This takes a few minutes.
Choose how Pipkin reaches a model. You can add more in Settings later.
Available once the Pipkin agent is installed.
